note.zh-TW: 教材列在營業外支出（T05）；間接法的加回列預設放在其他非現金損失增加（T12）。老師確認前不出分錄題。
note.en: The course lists it under non-operating expenses (T05); the indirect-method add-back goes by default to other non-cash losses (T12). No journal entry questions are set until the teacher confirms.

definition.zh-TW: 把先列為資產的設立費等遞延資產，依年限逐年轉成費用的金額。現行報表沒有這一項。
definition.en: The yearly charge that moves capitalised start-up costs and other deferred assets into expense over their amortisation period. Current statements have no such item.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 下設立費在發生時就已費用化，沒有可供攤銷的資產，所以不會有這筆費用；改用 IFRS 時之後各期的營業外支出減少，間接法也不再有這筆加回。
ifrsNote.en: Under IFRS start-up costs are expensed when incurred, so there is no asset to amortise and this expense does not arise; later periods show lower non-operating expenses and the indirect method has no add-back for it.
